self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: the equipping character's ATK is increased by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Triggers off-field.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members (the wearer included) is increased by 50%. Triggers off-field, and the DMG bonus does not stack across several copies of this set in the party. Applied as stellarglimmer_dmg_, the umbrella key that reaches both Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl hits, so this buff is correctly scoped for either. Stellar Swirl DMG itself is still unimplemented (no reaction constants), so a Swirl rotation has no hits for it to land on yet.

bonuses.4: Increases the equipping character's ATK by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Also increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members by 50%. The above effects can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field, and he DMG bonus from multiple Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.

Pendant 12 s après que le personnage équipé de l'artéfact a déclenché une réaction astrale ou infligé des DGT de réaction astrale, son ATQ augmente de 12 % et les DGT de réaction astrale infligés par tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité augmentent de 50 %. L'effet ci-dessus peut être déclenché même si le personnage n'est pas déployé, et les effets d'augmentation des DGT accordés par les sets d'artéfacts du même nom ne se cumulent pas.
